name: hypochord
definition: Portion of tissue that arises from the lateral edges of the shield and is located immediately ventral to the notochord. The hypochord is thought to play a role in positioning the dorsal aorta.

spatial.dv: directly ventral to the notochord, dorsal to the dorsal aorta
spatial.landmarks: a single row of cells under the notochord in trunk and tail

shape.notes: Thin strip (one cell wide) under the notochord from the anterior trunk to the tail. Visible only in section.

name: median fin fold
definition: Surface structure that will develop into one of the median fins.  Extends from dorsal surface of fish, caudal to the 8th somite, to the ventral surface ending at the caudal side of the vent.

spatial.dv: dorsal midline from somite 8 to the tail tip, around the tail, and ventral midline forward to the vent
spatial.landmarks: continuous transparent keel; tallest around the tail tip

shape.notes: Thin transparent sheet extruded from the dorsal and ventral midline curves. Height profile: zero at somite 8 and at the vent, rising to a maximum around the notochord tip. Add actinotrichia lines from 36 hpf. Keep until about 7.4 mm SL, then resorb between fins, leaving dorsal, anal and caudal fins.

name: head
definition: Organism subdivision which is the part of the body which consists of the cranial and pharyngeal regions.

spatial.dv: all
spatial.landmarks: snout to the posterior edge of the otic vesicle and pharyngeal arches; bent ventrally over the yolk at 24 hpf (HTA 120 deg)

shape.notes: Anterior body segment. Ellipsoid with the eyes as lateral bulges. Rotate ventrally relative to the trunk by the head-trunk angle: 120 deg (24 h), 95 (30 h), 75 (36 h), 55 (42 h), 45 (48 h), about 25 by 72 h.

name: pharyngeal arch
definition: One of a series of paired bony or cartilaginous arches that develop along the lateral walls of the foregut. There are seven pharyngeal arches.

spatial.dv: ventral half of the head behind the eye, lateral to the pharynx
spatial.landmarks: the pharyngeal region: between the eye and the heart; gill slits open at 48 to 72 hpf

shape.notes: Region node for the pharyngeal part of the head: seven paired transverse bars under the hindbrain. Render as a ventrolateral block of the head; the skeletal specialist supplies the cartilages.

events.event: ZFA start stage (10-13 somites)

name: trunk
definition: Organism subdivision which is the part of the body posterior to the head and anterior to the post-vent region.

spatial.dv: all; sits on top of the yolk ball and yolk extension
spatial.landmarks: from somite 1 to the vent (about somite 17); the yolk extension lies under it

shape.notes: Body segment between head and vent. Elliptical cross section, taller than wide. Its ventral side follows the yolk; the gut runs along the yolk extension.

name: post-vent region
definition: Organism subdivision which is the part of the body posterior to the vent which includes the anal and caudal fins.

spatial.dv: all; free of the yolk
spatial.landmarks: from the vent to the tail tip; 13 tail somites at 24 hpf; curls ventrally around the yolk before 22 hpf, then straightens

shape.notes: Tapered body segment behind the vent, wrapped by the median fin fold. Curve it ventrally around the yolk until 22 hpf, straighten by 48 hpf, and bend the tip dorsally (flexion) from 4.5 mm SL.
